claim_citation.quote: In despair, he creates a construct of his dead little sister, Ellie, to calm his mother.

candidates.summary: The most insane construct in the set: John creates a realistic dead-sister construct to comfort his dementia-stricken mother. This is a temporary, emotionally targeted construct that later becomes an ongoing autonomous presence in the run.
candidates.title: Dead-sister construct Ellie
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John manifests Ellie as a lifelike construct and presents her to his mother as a comforting companion.

claim_citation.quote: John Stewart and Martian Manhunter find that the planet, Xanshi, has been infected by the Anti-Life Aspect. After evading a volcanic eruption, John arrogantly blames Manhunter for holding him back, restraining him in a construct bubble.

candidates.summary: Partial construct. John made an energy bubble to hold Martian Manhunter back so he could rush ahead alone; the attempt ended in catastrophe when Xanshi was destroyed.
candidates.title: Cosmic Odyssey
candidates.what_visibly_happens: He forms a glowing bubble around Martian Manhunter and pushes on without him, trying to handle the crisis by himself.

candidates.character_or_thing: Kryptonite construct for the Thanagar vault

claim_citation.quote: John Stewart, thanks to his willpower-made ring, creates a construct with the properties of Kryptonite, substituting it with a special piece of Kryptonite which was carried inside the vault by two Dominators.

candidates.summary: Assisted/temporary construct. John makes a counterfeit Kryptonite construct to fool security and get the team into the vault.
candidates.title: Justice League: Escape from Hawkworld: Part Two
candidates.what_visibly_happens: He creates a green Kryptonite-shaped construct that passes the vault’s security check.

claim_citation.quote: During this scene, he comically beams a larger-than-life Superman to deflect the energy blasts off his chest as if they were bullets, and later uses a wrecking ball to pummel the rest of Kanjar Ro's forces.

candidates.summary: Showy full construct. John creates a gigantic Superman-shaped construct as battlefield protection and then follows it with a wrecking-ball construct.
candidates.title: Green Lantern Corps
candidates.what_visibly_happens: A giant Superman-shaped projection appears in front of him to soak up incoming blasts, then a wrecking ball swings into the enemy line.

claim_citation.quote: John Stewart decided to build a sniper rifle construct that was so precise and deadly that it only took one shot to thwart the threat from such a long distance.

candidates.summary: Assisted/weapon construct. John forms a sniper rifle with enough precision to make a single, long-range disabling shot.
candidates.title: Green Lantern Corps
candidates.what_visibly_happens: He manifests a rifle, sights the target at extreme range, and fires one precise shot.
